Edit the supplied approved stone tile. KEEP the complete stone block: its blue-grey cracked 4:3 diamond top, brick masonry side faces, proportions, viewpoint, position in the square canvas, framing, 64px side depth and natural material details. Do not replace or remove the stone block. Background outside the complete block remains real alpha transparency. Deliver one entire isolated burning tile, not an effect-only layer.
HIGHEST PRIORITY: the user dislikes tall flames. The fire must be an extremely LOW, THIN, GROUND-HUGGING surface effect. Every flame tongue is wider than it is tall and rises at most roughly 6-8 native game pixels on a 128-pixel-wide tile (one sixteenth of tile width). Mostly use flat hot color patches and short horizontal flickers. The BACK edge, middle and FRONT edge all have the SAME very low flame height. Never build a triangular bonfire silhouette. NO tall central flame, NO tall pointed tip, NO large curling plume, NO bonfire, NO smoke column, NO floating sparks, NO high vertical silhouette. The original top-plane geometry should remain easy to read.
The entire upper diamond is burning right out to all four corners and every edge: uniform full-tile coverage, not a small central patch, not merely a perimeter ring, not isolated sparse campfires. Keep all vertical masonry side faces clearly exposed and recognizable, without flowing fire on them. Preserve generous transparent margins and the complete uncut stone block. No characters, text, symbols, new props, logs, coal pile, brazier or scene background. No additional pixelation filter.

This variant's distinctive visual style: Very restrained soft luminous game effect: translucent amber warmth spread over the full stone top, small low orange curls and a few warm cream points of light. Gentle local glow kept on the surface, never a large bloom or smoke cloud.
Specific silhouette variation: include many visibly UPRIGHT but TINY squat flame tongues standing just a little above the stone, about 4-6% of the tile width high. A few small tips may protrude by this same small amount at the rear/side edge. The effect has shallow physical height and should not read merely as a painted decal or lava cracks. Heights stay evenly low across the field, with NO central peak. These little flame nubs are all broad and short, never long or tall.

variants.name: Пепельный жар
variants.style: Ash-muted fire palette: dark desaturated terracotta and dusky grey-red shading on the top with small ochre and amber flickers distributed across every edge and middle. Soft chalky painterly finish, subdued and compact, no airborne smoke and no solid ash piles.
